answer: Because each island escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the violet ledger records every share and the signal audit shows the split. Assembling that for 38 aliases means 38 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
